resources.string: Already on — no action needed here. Continue to the next step.
Already on — connect the phone to your computer by USB.
Ready — Sukut can process audio. No activation needed.
Already on — you can activate Sukut on this phone.
Turn on Developer options to allow activation. This does not activate the audio worker by itself.
Turn on USB debugging before activating from your computer.
Activation needed — start the audio worker to use Sukut.
Turn on Wireless debugging to activate on this phone. Android may ask you to approve this Wi-Fi network.
The audio worker is not running. Activate it again, or open the step-by-step guide if you need help. Your setup and mode choices are saved.
Developer options and Wireless debugging are on.
Optional: add the Debugging tile. It switches Developer options and your activation connection. Turning it off can stop Sukut.
